definitions.explanation: The state of being free from harm, accident, or trouble.
Completing something without problems or accidents.

examples.japanese: {家族|かぞく}は{無事|ぶじ}です。
{全員|ぜんいん}{無事|ぶじ}だった。
{地震|じしん}の{後|あと}、{友達|ともだち}の{無事|ぶじ}を{確|たし}かめた。
examples.english: After the earthquake, I confirmed that my friend was safe.

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}が{無事|ぶじ}に{終|お}わりました。
examples.english: The exam finished without any problems.

examples.japanese: {長|なが}い{旅|たび}だったが、{無事|ぶじ}に{家|いえ}に{帰|かえ}ることができた。
examples.english: It was a long trip, but I was able to get home safely.

notes:
{無事|ぶじ} indicates safety or the absence of problems.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {無事|ぶじ}に (safely, successfully)
- Na-adjective: {無事|ぶじ}な (safe)
- Noun: {無事|ぶじ} (safety)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {無事|ぶじ}に{着|つ}く (arrive safely)
- {無事|ぶじ}に{終|お}わる (end without incident)
- {無事|ぶじ}を{祈|いの}る (pray for safety)
- ご{無事|ぶじ}で (take care/be safe)

EXPRESSION:
「お{無事|ぶじ}で{何|なに}よりです」(I'm relieved you're safe) - common polite expression
